answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The tundra lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lantern is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
